title: Millefeuille Temporary Bridge Ownership
description: Content-addressed ownership proof for one abandoned, unpublished temporary bridge generation.
x-millefeuille-semantic-validation: The generation directory name must match .millefeuille-bridge.tmp- followed by exactly 16 lowercase hexadecimal characters and be a direct child of the explicitly supplied source root.

Compute integrity.content_digest over canonical UTF-8 JSON of every top-level field except integrity; reject duplicate keys, non-finite numbers, unknown fields, credentials, URLs, and private byte markers.
Inventory paths must be sorted, unique, flat, slash-normalized relative filenames; ownership.json is reserved and every inventory entry must be a singly linked no-follow regular file.

The directory entry set must equal ownership.json plus inventory exactly. Every size and SHA-256 must match stable descriptor reads; links, reparse points, hard links, missing entries, extra entries, writable generations, and drift are refusal conditions.
